research_design.development_result: A 30-day official-Binance development study found strong same-minute major-coin co-movement, negative BTC-to-ETH/SOL lag-one correlation, and no useful unconditional three-state Markov direction forecast. A sparse dynamic-leader ETH subset was encouraging but statistically unresolved. None of those rows count as forward evidence.
research_design.selection_correction: No ETH-only arm was selected from the 23-event positive development subset. BTC, ETH, SOL and XRP remain pre-declared reporting arms, and both strategies join the full H1-H75 multiple-testing family.
research_design.minute_integrity: Only a continuous suffix of complete one-minute snapshots is eligible. A collector gap resets the effective model history; repeated one-second evaluations do not create extra observations.
research_design.common_executable_hurdle: The mechanism-adjusted conservative selected-side fair lower bound minus executable ask minus 2x crypto taker fees must exceed one token tick. The same quote must not already qualify before the model adjustment.
research_design.capacity_rule: At most $10 intended notional and 20% of displayed touch; minimum $1 executable notional.
research_design.independent_unit: One Polymarket fifteen-minute market/window. UTC day and asset are mandatory additional clusters.
research_design.situational_reuse_rule: Rejected strategies are not retrospectively filtered into profitable regimes. Any future regime overlay requires a fresh strategy ID, an unchanged matched source arm and a new evidence clock.
research_design.no_live_claim: Both arms are shadow-only. A positive point estimate is not proof and cannot authorize a real-money order path.

strategy_bindings.development_prior: negative; retained as a strict falsification arm, not a profitability claim

fixed_rules.stability: positive lag slope and Fisher-correlation lower 95% bound in each separate two-hour half
fixed_rules.leader_selection: largest minimum lower-bound lag correlation; BTC is not privileged
fixed_rules.leader_return_shock: at or above trailing four-hour absolute-return 95th percentile
fixed_rules.leader_flow_shock: same sign as return and at or above trailing absolute-flow 75th percentile
fixed_rules.target_underresponse: at most half fitted contemporaneous response and less absolute flow than leader

strategy_bindings.development_prior: weak and sparse; ETH 3-minute subset n=23, +2.645 bps signed return, 65.2% hit rate, Wilson 44.9%-81.2%

evaluation.multiple_testing: Holm-family correction across H1-H75, forward clones, live-derived variants and every discarded pilot.
evaluation.shared_bankroll: Portfolio replay with one shared $500 bankroll; strategy or asset-arm PnL must not be naively summed.
evaluation.promotion: No live path. Passing the mechanical read only triggers a separate authenticated $1-$2, 50-fill pilot review.
evaluation.null_outcome: No qualifying orders, approximately zero edge, or negative edge are valid outcomes. Thresholds, asset selection and signal direction cannot be changed from this forward cohort.
